---
title: "check-def-commentary.yml"
---

Diff-scoped, blocking check that flags commentary written inside a `#def-` div.
A definition div holds the definition, its notation and its display equation only.
Commentary, contrasts, motivation and history go in a `#rem-` div right after it,
one div per subfile.
This implements
[gha#1180](https://github.com/Morrison-Lab/gha/issues/1180).

The check reports a sentence inside a `::: {#def-...}` div that opens with
"It is not", "This is not", "That is not", "Note that", "Notice that",
"Unlike", "Do not confuse", "Be careful", "Beware", "In contrast",
"By contrast", "Intuitively", "Informally" or "Historically".
The finding sits on the line that holds the sentence.

The check does not read:

- lines inside a code fence, display math (`$$`) or an HTML comment;
- inline code;
- a div nested inside the definition (only the definition's own lines);
- a line carrying `<!-- check-def-commentary: allow -->`,
  for a sentence that really is part of the definition.

The heuristic is noisy by design, and the marker is its escape hatch.

## Scope

Only an added line is reported.
The whole file is parsed, since the div opens far above the changed line.
An added line whose exact text was also deleted in the same diff counts as moved.
With no `base-ref`, or when the diff cannot be computed,
the check skips with a warning instead of scanning the whole tree.
Set `whole-tree: true` to scan every tracked file on purpose,
which measures how many existing definitions carry commentary.
`fail` defaults to `true`, because a diff-scoped check reflags nothing already merged.

## Usage

Copy
[`examples/check-def-commentary.yml`](https://github.com/Morrison-Lab/gha/blob/main/examples/check-def-commentary.yml)
to `.github/workflows/` in your repository.

## Inputs

| Input | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `globs` | `*.qmd` | Space-separated git pathspecs of tracked files to check |
| `paths-ignore` | empty | Comma- or newline-separated glob patterns to skip |
| `fail` | `true` | Fail the workflow on a finding instead of warning |
| `whole-tree` | `false` | Scan every definition, not only a pull request's additions |
| `runs-on` | `ubuntu-latest` | Runner label; self-hosted only for a private repository |
| `python-version` | `3.x` | Python version to set up |

## Permissions

The job needs `contents: read` only.

## Example

```yaml
name: Check definition divs for commentary

on:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  check:
    uses: Morrison-Lab/gha/.github/workflows/check-def-commentary.yml@v3
    with:
      paths-ignore: 'chapters/outtakes/**'
```
